$comment: Sample backlog for a team lunch poll app. Items point at REQUIREMENTS.md instead of copying the ACs. Order matters: the loop takes the first item whose dependsOn are done. Refs assume the pair is installed as loop/backlog.json and docs/REQUIREMENTS.md.

items.title: Create a poll
items.scope: Table polls and options in a new migration, RLS default deny, a SECURITY DEFINER function create_poll. The create form and the share link. Covers AC-1.1, AC-1.2, AC-1.3.

items.title: Vote on a poll
items.scope: Table votes keyed by poll and a browser token, a SECURITY DEFINER function cast_vote that replaces an earlier vote. The vote page at /p/[id]. Covers AC-1.4, AC-1.5, AC-1.6.

items.title: Show results and close at the deadline
items.scope: Vote counts on the poll page while open; at the closing time cast_vote refuses and the page shows the winner or the tied options. The closing check lives in the database function, not in application code. Covers AC-2.1, AC-2.2.

items.title: Email sending with a preview stub
items.scope: sendEmail() through the email provider, routed to the stub when APP_ENV=preview, with an email log table. The provider account and domain are owner actions. Covers AC-2.4.

items.title: Reminder 15 minutes before closing
items.scope: A scheduled job that sends one reminder per poll 15 minutes before closing, marked as sent in the database so it never goes twice. Covers AC-2.3.
